name: Nothing Phone 3a/Pro
tagline: Experience the perfect blend of performance and customization with our Pixel-inspired custom ROM for your device.

steps.title: Unlock Bootloader
steps.description: Ensure your device's bootloader is unlocked before proceeding.

steps.title: Reboot To Bootloader
steps.description: Reboot to Bootloader/Fastboot by pressing Vol Down + Power Button.

steps.title: Connection
steps.description: Open CMD or Terminal on your PC and connect your phone via USB.

steps.title: Reboot To FastbootD
steps.description:
Reboot to FastbootD by typing:
fastboot reboot fastboot

steps.title: Install Core System Files
steps.description:
Flash core partitions by typing:
fastboot flash boot boot.img
fastboot flash dtbo dtbo.img
fastboot flash vendor_boot vendor_boot.img
fastboot flash init_boot init_boot.img
fastboot flash recovery recovery.img

steps.title: Reboot To Bootloader
steps.description:
Reboot into Bootloader by typing:
fastboot reboot bootloader

steps.title: Reboot To FastbootD Of New Recovery
steps.description:
Reboot to FastbootD by typing:
fastboot reboot fastboot

steps.title: Wipe Super
steps.description:
Wipe Super by typing:
fastboot wipe-super super_empty.img

steps.title: Reboot To Bootloader
steps.description:
Reboot into Bootloader (again) by typing:
fastboot reboot bootloader

steps.title: Reboot To Recovery
steps.description:
Reboot into Recovery by typing:
fastboot reboot recovery

steps.title: Flash Clover ROM
steps.description:
In recovery, navigate to Apply Update → Apply from ADB, then sideload the ROM by typing:
adb sideload CloverProject*.zip
If prompted to install additional packages, choose No.

steps.title: Wipe Data
steps.description: From the main recovery menu, select Factory Reset → Format data/factory reset. (Skip this step if you are dirty updating from an earlier build of this ROM).

steps.title: Reboot
steps.description: Select Reboot system now. The first boot may take a few minutes. Enjoy Clover!

installationGuide.warning: Incorrect installation may brick your device. We are not responsible for any damage to your device. Proceed at your own risk.
